Giovanni Gibertoni and Alberto Besozzi took part in **EMBC 2026**, the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society, held at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre in Toronto, Canada, on 26–30 July 2026.

![Presenting "A Charge-Integrated Modular NIR Armband for Forearm Optical Myography" at IEEE EMBC 2026, Metro Toronto Convention Centre.](/assets/images/news-embc-2026-toronto.jpg){fig-alt="A speaker at a lectern beside a screen showing the title slide of the OptoLAB paper at IEEE EMBC 2026"}
